mentions.description: A Rust Text User Interface (TUI) framework that is modular, declarative, event-driven, and reactive. It builds cross-platform apps from one unified code base, compilable for the terminal (macOS, Windows, Linux), a standalone native window (macOS & Windows 11), or the browser via WASM.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still changing along on Incredible (https://www.incredible.rs/) a Rust Text User Interface (TUI) Framework for the 2nd Quarter of the 21st Century.

It is New, Experimental, Modular, Declarative, Event Driven and Reactive. It builds cross-platform apps that can be compiled for the terminal (macOs, Windows, Linux), a standalone native window (macOS & Windows 11), or the browser (via WASM) from one unified code base.
mentions.author: incrediblers
